sloka: अब्रवीद् राक्षसान् सर्वान् ह्रिया किम्चिद् अवान् मुखः ।धर्षिता च प्रविष्टा च लंका दुष्प्रसहा पुरी ॥६-६-२॥।।
transliteration: abravīd rākṣasān sarvān hriyā kimcid avān mukhaḥ ।dharṣitā ca praviṣṭā ca laṁkā duṣprasahā purī ॥6-6-2॥।।

translations.english: "(Hanuman) After all a monkey in size, entered the inaccessible city of Lanka, destroyed it and saw Sita, daughter of king of Janaka."
